meta.name: agent-council
meta.description: Use when facing trade-offs, subjective judgments, uncertain decisions, or when diverse viewpoints would improve judgment quality. Triggers include "council", "다른 의견", "perspectives", "what do others think".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发起多方意见征询，辅助复杂决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常因信息不足或视角单一而犹豫不决。
copy.tagline_en: Gather multiple perspectives to make better decisions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with decisions due to limited viewpoints.

howto.what: 当 Claude 遇到不确定的决策时，它会启动一个由多个 AI 模型组成的顾问委员会，各自给出独立意见，然后由 Claude 作为主席综合这些意见，最终你来做决定。
howto.when: 当你面临权衡取舍、主观判断或不确定决策，需要多样化观点时，说出“council”、“다른 의견”或“perspectives”等关键词即可触发。

say.text: 请召集 council 评估这个架构决策。
say.note: Claude 会启动委员会并综合意见。

say.text: 我想听听不同观点，启动 council。
say.note: 委员会成员给出独立意见。

say.text: 对于这个风险评价，请 council 给出意见。
say.note: Claude 综合后生成咨询报告。

howto.what_en: When facing an uncertain decision, Claude activates a council of multiple AI models to provide independent opinions, then synthesizes them as chairman, leaving the final decision to you.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you face trade-offs, subjective judgments, or uncertain decisions needing diverse perspectives. Say "council", "다른 의견", or "perspectives".

say_en.text: Please convene the council to evaluate this architectural decision.
say_en.note: Claude launches the council and synthesizes opinions.

say_en.text: I want to hear different perspectives; start the council.
For this risk assessment, please ask the council for advice.
say_en.note: Claude synthesizes and produces an advisory report.
